description: PolarDB provides the Agentic Database form factor for large-scale AI Agent scenarios. Built on an agile serverless architecture, Agentic Database supports extreme elasticity with Scale to Zero, switching between branches in seconds, in-database multimodal fusion retrieval and inference, and native MCP/CLI interaction. This provides a highly cost-effective database service for AI Agent applications.
description_cn: PolarDB 面向海量 AI Agent 智能体场景，提供 Agentic Database 形态，100% 兼容 MySQL 协议，支持 Serverless Scale to Zero 极致弹性、秒级 Branch 分支穿梭、Agent Context 上下文记录、记忆动态实时抽取、企业级知识管理协作、多模融合检索，提供 MCP 统一适配接入层，为 AI Agent 智能体提供极致性价比的 AI-Native 数据服务。

tools.description: Execute a single SQL statement on your AgenticDB instance. Returns {columns, rows, row_count, truncated, next_cursor?}. Binary values are {type: 'bytes', encoding: 'hex', value: '<hex>'}. If truncated=true, pass next_cursor as cursor to fetch the next page. Destructive operations (DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE without WHERE) require confirm=true; blocked statements are rejected outright. For multiple statements, use run_sql_transaction.
tools.name: run_sql

tools.description: Execute multiple SQL statements with BEGIN/COMMIT and rollback on error. Atomic rollback applies to transactional DML only. MySQL DDL and other implicit-commit statements may persist changes even if a later statement fails. Returns {results: [{columns, rows, row_count, truncated}, ...]}. Binary values are {type: 'bytes', encoding: 'hex', value: '<hex>'}.
tools.name: run_sql_transaction

tools.description: Inspect the structure of your AgenticDB. Without 'table': lists tables in the database (with columns unless include_columns=false), paginated via cursor. With 'table': returns that table's columns and indexes. database is optional and defaults to your provisioned database.
tools.name: describe_schema
